description.text: Starter Set ex Quaxly & Mimikyu ex, one of three starter sets released on 20 January 2023, the day the Scarlet & Violet series began with the Scarlet ex and Violet ex expansions. Its deck pairs Quaxly and its evolutions with Mimikyu ex, whose attacks can switch it to the Bench after hitting or do 30 damage for each Energy attached to both Active Pokémon. Each box held a ready-to-play 60-card deck with one Pokémon ex, damage counters and markers, a coin, a playmat, a rule book and a guide, and a promo pack with one card drawn at random from four: two suited to its deck and two that suit any of them, Cyclizar ex among them.
